item.title: Setup
item.description:
Everything in this workshop runs on your own laptop. You install one Anaconda environment and register it as one Jupyter kernel, and that covers both days. Day 1 opens with a setup hour from 12:00 to 13:00 where we go through this together, so if something below does not work, bring it there.

Each step ends with a check you can run.
